class.name: WedgeShape3D
class.brief_description: A wedge cut from a vertical cylinder, like a slice of cheese.
class.description: A vertical circular sector with two radial faces meeting at the local Y axis. The wedge is centered on local +Z, and its angular extent is symmetric about that direction. Assign this resource to a CollisionShape3D to obtain full collisions for angles from 0 to 360 degrees. Angles greater than 180 degrees are concave and are assembled from multiple convex collision pieces. This assembly works with Godot Physics and Jolt, including dynamic PhysicsBody3D nodes. The circular edge is polygonal, approximated according to radial_segments. Angle 0 creates no collision entries when used by CollisionShape3D. Directly using the inherited RID in PhysicsServer3D only represents the first convex sector when angle exceeds 180 degrees. Use CollisionShape3D for the complete shape.

members.member: Distance from the center axis to the outer circular edge, in meters.
Full vertical extent of the wedge, in meters.
Slice angle in degrees, from 0 to 360. 360 creates a full cylinder.
Target tessellation around a full circle, between 8 and 256. Each convex piece receives at least two arc segments.
